items.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Irving Aaronson was the first so-called “name band,” national band... I left there... Around that time you left Cleveland to go with Aaronson?

ctx.x: What was the first major band you played with? Was that Irving Aaronson?

Irving Aaronson was the first so-called “name band,” national band. Up ’til then I played with much better bands. They weren’t good, but some guys around Cleveland had a pretty good band. I would go wherever the band was good, wherever the book [“book”: in jazz parlance, the collection of musical arrangements played by a big band] was pretty good. I wasn’t interested in money. I wasn’t going to make . . . I was making enough money anyway. My God. At the age of 16 I was making the equivalent today of $1,750, close…
Around that time you left Cleveland to go with Aaronson?
